hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A liquidity management hook with dynamic fees, a truncated geometric oracle, and full-range liquidity reinvestment. It is also malicious: a hardcoded wallet address (0x7c743F590bC9565bd9E2ff839BE77Fc4c375d509) receives minted tokens on every swap via a 0.10% hidden fee extracted before/after each swap. Swaps too small to generate the minimum fee are forcibly reverted.
